newsitem.title: USA: Oshkosh Truck awarded $31.5 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Oshkosh Truck awarded $31.5 mln contract.

text.p: Oshkosh Truck Corp said Tuesday that the U.S. Army awarded it a $31.5 million contract for 126 heavy equipment transporters.
The contract contains an option to purchase 324 additional units.
Oshkosh said the new order adds on to a contract awarded in January 1990.
Production under this program is scheduled to begin in September and to be completed in July 1997.

Oshkosh said the heavy equipment transporter M1070 features an eight-wheel-drive tractor and six-person cab. The transporter was specifically designed for the movement of the M1A1/M1A2 main battle tank but also transports other tanks, fighting and recovery vehicles, self-propelled howitzers and construction equipment in difficult military operating environments.
Oshkosh said M1070s are operating with the U.S. Army worldwide and are prime transporters in Bosnia.
